notes.title: July Highlights: Upcoming Discount, Offline Events & Content Updates
notes.notes:
[p]Dear players and supporters,[/p][p]It has been nearly three weeks since the release of [i]Throne of Monsters[/i]. Thanks to your feedback and continued support, the game has now reached a stable and functional state. We deeply appreciate all your comments, suggestions, and bug reports.[/p][p]Here are a few important announcements:[/p][hr][/hr][h3]1. Next Discount Scheduled for August 12[/h3][p]Due to bugs present during our initial launch, we will be hosting a [b]new discount event on August 12[/b], offering the [b]same 10% discount[/b] as the release sale.[/p][p](We previously announced the discount would occur on July 23, but we miscalculated Steam’s cooldown period for discounts. Our sincere apologies for the confusion.)[/p][hr][/hr][h3]2. Digital Artbook DLC Will Become Paid Content in August[/h3][p]Originally intended as a launch bonus, the [b]Digital Artbook DLC will soon switch from free to paid[/b], with a price of [b]9 RMB[/b].[/p][list][*][p]We are currently coordinating with Steam regarding the price change and cannot confirm the exact date. However, we [b]expect the transition to happen before the next discount on August 12[/b].[/p][/*][*][p]In August, we also plan to [b]update the Artbook[/b] with additional character designs and environment illustrations.[/p][/*][/list][hr][/hr][h3]3. Ongoing Game Optimization[/h3][p]We are still working on improving and fixing in-game issues. However, due to high development workload, some fixes may be delayed. We sincerely apologize for this.[/p][p]The following fixes are planned to be released before August:[/p][list][*][p]🛠 [b]Gallery – Credits page missing names[/b] due to pagination bug[/p][/*][*][p]🛠 [b]Exploration – Incorrect left-facing idle frame[/b] for the protagonist[/p][/*][*][p]🛠 [b]Exploration – Invisible walls[/b] in some empty areas that prevent movement[/p][/*][*][p]🛠 [b]Typographical errors[/b] and text corrections[/p][/*][/list][p]Thank you again for all your feedback and suggestions.[/p][hr][/hr][h2]🎉 \[Extra News] – Community & Offline Events[/h2][h3]1. New Crowdfunding Campaign in Preparation[/h3][p]To support our studio and continue development, we are planning a new [b]merchandise crowdfunding campaign[/b].[/p][p]The campaign will feature:[/p][list][*][p]Products based on characters’ post-story appearances[/p][/*][*][p]Scene-themed decorative stickers[/p][/*][*][p]A re-release of our popular [b]journal notebook[/b][/p][/*][/list][p]Expected launch: [b]Late July to early August[/b] – please stay tuned![/p][hr][/hr][h3]2. Two Offline Events – Guangzhou & Shenzhen[/h3][list][*][p][b]Guangzhou – KKWorld (by Kuaikan)[/b]
📅 [i]July 18–21[/i]
📍 Poly World Trade Center Expo[/p][/*][*][p][b]Shenzhen – Comic Festival[/b]
📅 [i]July 25–27[/i]
📍 Shenzhen Convention & Exhibition Center (Futian)[/p][/*][/list][p]🎁 Free gifts will be available for attendees. We’d love to meet you in person![/p][hr][/hr][h3]3. REPO & Fan Promotion Gift Campaign[/h3][p]We’re continuing to collect fan creations on [b]Bilibili, Weibo, and Xiaohongshu[/b].[/p][p]🎁 Selected creators will receive official merchandise as a thank-you![/p][p]To participate, please post your content using [b]#怪物的王座[/b] (The Throne of The Monster) tag. Our staff will reach out to you, or feel free to message our official accounts or community admins directly.[/p][hr][/hr][p]Thank you for reading! We’ll keep working hard to bring you even more exciting content.[/p]

notes.title: An apology letter to the player
notes.notes: [p]Hello everyone, I'm crucis, the producer of "The Throne of The Monsters". I'm in charge of screenwriting, text, planning and UI.[/p][p]First of all, I would like to apologize for the serious BUG that occurred after the launch. I'm really sorry for causing frequent interruptions to the players who made the initial purchase. This part is due to issues with the project schedule, which prevented a thorough BUG investigation in time. Part of the reason is that my coding skills, which are responsible for writing text and configuration tasks, are too poor. Here, I would like to extend my deep apologies to all of you.[/p][p]Now, 99% of the bugs in the game have been fixed. We have also made several rounds of corrections, mainly focusing on issues related to performances and battles. If you are interested, we still sincerely welcome you to come and experience it.[/p][p]One month after the end of the initial offer (July 23rd), we will launch another 14-day promotion at the same price as this initial offer (the art setting DLC is an exclusive benefit for the initial offer and will not be included later).[/p]

C:\\Users\\Administrator\\AppData\\LocalLow\\ChuxingGame\\TheThroneOfTheMonster\\SaveFiles


Return to the game and find the save file of this number. Directly click on the interaction point in front of you to pass the blocked part


-


The cause of the BUG: The guidance is not clear, the code is written incorrectly, and the condition for determining the number of enemies defeated is written as =3 instead of >3, which leads to the interaction of players who have defeated more than 3 monsters not taking effect.


The technical ability is too poor. I'm deeply reflecting on it... We are making every effort to investigate other problems...[/p]
